newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Zambia Sugar leads trade.

text.p: - Traded volume rose on the Lusaka Stock Exchange (LuSE) in the week ended September 27 as buyers snapped up a floatation by newly listed Zambia Sugar, exchange officials said.
They said the week saw 20 trades with a volume of 94,550 shares worth 1,874,775 kwacha, up from 14 trades with a volume of 46,605 shares worth 2,425,726 kwacha the previous week.
Zambia Sugar, trading at 15 kwacha, saw two trades with a volume of 39,500 shaes valued at 592,500 kwacha.
Chilanga Cements rose one kwacha to end the week at 55 kwacha, and saw two trades with a volume of 2,659 kwacha valued at 147,325 kwacha.
Farmers House remained steady at 300 kwacha and saw one trade with a volume of 10 shares worth 3,000 kwacha.
Rothmans remained steady at 35 kwacha and saw one trade with a volume of 2,280 shares valued at 79,800 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) saw no trades during the week.
